Bettly? ... Bettly? ... how is she not here?
We came to get her to go with her!
On the appointment Daniel is not faithful,

Without seeing the effect of our cunning,

or our friends of the mountain
Will be jealous of my destiny!

Will be jealous of my destiny!

That poor boy is so happy.
See you tonight! ... see you tonight! ...
Ah, how much he loves him!
I want this place right here.
I have here his letter, I have his promise: "Mr Daniel, I love you, and today I will be your wife."

I confess that it surprised me, because never mademoiselle Bettly had given me hope!., on the contrary .... but they say that the pretty girls have whims, and in that capacity she has the right to have it; it is not I who will be mad at her! ... I am only mad at her for having come out so early ... she must have known that I would run in the field! and God knows if I breathed myself to climb the mountain! ... After all, she did well to decide ... It is so long that I love her ... and then, as they say, the years come.
Oh, there it is! ... there it is! ... it's her!
Here! ... it's you, Mr. Daniel? how are you here? ...
That's your question! ...I, Miss Bettly, will ask you how you're not there?
Because the collector made me say yesterday that he had a letter for me: it could only be from my brother Max ... So, in my impatience, I couldn't wait ... I was looking for her! ... there she is!
Is he doing well, Mr. Max? ... He wasn't killed? ...
It's true! ... it's that the soldiers, that ... often happens to them... he over-all who has been fighting for so long!

For fifteen years he has left us! ... I was very young ... but I still remember the day of his departure; when, the bag on his back, he bid farewell to my father and my mother ... who lived then! ... and I took him on his knees and said to me: Farewell, little sister; if I am not killed, I will return to dance at your wedding.
That is to say, no ... It is wrong! Because, although I want to meet Mr. Max, I do not care to wait for his return, for our marriage ...
Our marriage! ... Where did you get these ideas?

Pardi! de vous, mam'selle ... For I, too Derouting his letter, received there a letter ... a ben kind letter, which does not come to me from a brother ... but from a person whom I cherish more than anything in the world ... more than myself!
Well! ... You look at me there in an astonished look ... You know well that this post where they promise to marry me ... is signed by you? ...
From me? it's not possible! ... and for good reasons ... First I can't read or write ... i.e. sign my name, and very nicely... but it's not like that.
Is it possible! ...This love, this marriage ... all the happiness that there was in there, you didn't promise ... you didn't think so?
So I'm crazy! ...I'm losing my mind! What does that mean?
It means, my poor boy, that the young girls and the young people in the village made fun of you and me!
What a perfidy! ... what a betrayal! ... I only have to go and throw myself in the lake ...
Do you know well, ma'am, that I invited them all to my wedding for tonight; that I ordered the violins ... that I ordered the meal? ...

I threw up all my barrels; I killed an ox, two sheep ... strangled all my ducks! ... What do you want, I was so happy ... I wanted everyone to feel it! ... I wasn't there anymore ... I didn't know myself ... and it's nothing yet! ... I did well worse than that ... I ran to the notary ...

No, ma'am... but I forced him to make me a marriage contract on the spot where I give you everything I have ... For I am the richest in the country ... I have three hundred cows in the mountains, a factory and two farmhouses ... And all this was yours, as well as me, over the market ... I had signed it, here it is ... and instead I am lost, dishonored in the canton! ... They will point my finger at me.
And so I! ... expose me, compromise me at this point! Has anyone ever seen such an extravagance? without thinking, without consulting me, believe in such a letter! ...
Lady, we believe so quickly in happiness! ... And then, all those people who will mock and mock me... It would be so easy for us, if you wanted to... to make fun of us! ...
By only putting your name at the bottom of this page ...
Do you think about it? ...It would all be over, we would be married.
And I don't want to... you know... I don't want to hear about marriage, I swear...
In this modest and simple asylum
No one can command anything but me!
I can run everything, I believe,
Without a husband rumbling after me;
Wanted to make the big eyes,
Tra, la, la, la, tra la,
I'd go, when I'm my mistress,
Only good of life, etc., etc.
Tra la la! tra la la! ... it's not reasons. God! if I had enough spirit to find it as I would prove you ...
That you have to take a husband! ...
And what's it gonna do me for?
To what? ... You're making me a funny question! ... It would be useful to love you ... is that nothing?
So really! ... but you see that you love me without that ... that I can count on your friendship ...
Like you on mine! ... For, you see, Daniel, I do justice to your good qualities ... You are a brave boy ... an excellent heart ... and if I married someone, I would choose you.
But calm down ... I will not marry anyone! ... it's stronger than me... so don't talk about it anymore ... never talk to me about it! ... and, to stop thinking about it, do me a favor.
A service! Speak, ma'am... Where to go? What to do?
Only read me this letter from my brother... because I, as I told you, am not strong! ...I am not like you...
Who learned to read, write and calculate at the college in Zurich ... the great advance! ... We are right to say that the scholarship does not make happiness ... Renewing strongly
So done... so done... at this moment! ... since I can do you a favor... let's see...
And we are in the middle of July... it seems that the letter has been on the way for a long time! ...
It's not surprising... Prince Charles' army and Souwarof's army are retreating in front of Masséna's soldiers, who intercept all communications.
"Nothing else, my dear Bettly, except that I always fight and my regiment, in the service of Austria, which we have enough ... I was hoping for a leave to go and kiss you..."
After fifteen years of absence! ...what a happiness! ... my poor brother! ...

"But it seems that it is no longer necessary to count on it. What is bothering me, my dear sister, is that when I came back, I expected to find a regiment of nieces and nephews in your house, and I see from your last one that you have not yet begun! However, it would soon be time to start ... a girl of your age cannot remain useless ..." That is true!
If you don't like it, I won't read any more.
"Why don't you marry a good boy of the country whose marriage I have received? ..."
And who then dared to write to him? ...
So it was only his that I asked! It seems to me that when you legitimately love... it is first of all to the family that you have to address ... Do you have to continue? ...
"It seems to me a good party: he is of an honest family, he is rich, he loves you very deeply...
"But this is not a reason to refuse it ... on the contrary! I will take information, and, if it suits you, you will have to marry it very badly ..."
It's too much! ... my brother himself does not have the right to compel me ... and it is enough for him to demand it so that my indifference becomes hatred ...
Let's finish, I'm going to the market...
DANIEL wanting to help him put his hood on
If, at least I'd come with you...

I don't want it! And I also tell you that you are only seen here all day long, that it can harm me and compromise me ... The girls of the country are so bad tongues! ... So, from today, I don't want you to come to my house... to compel me! ... Ah! well yes! I said it... you hear me; arrange yourself!
It's over! It's the coup de grace!

I'm only looking for which one will be the most advantageous for me to throw myself from the top of the mountain or to go into the lake! ... I have no other party to take ... what is boring is to perish yourself ... First our pastor says that it's not good ... and then it's unpleasant! ... and if I had any friend to do this service to me ...

Military men who climb the mountain... would they be French, Austrians or Russians? ... No! ... compatriots, soldiers of the country... that's what I need... that they take me with them... that they will engage... there will be some gable if some ball does not do me the service that I asked earlier, and at least I won't have my death to blame.
This way, gentlemen, this way. If mam'selle Bettly were there, she would do them the honors; I will replace her.
Let's stop a little! ... The appearance of our mountains,
Of drunkenness and happiness makes my heart tremble!
A moment of rest in these green countryside
We will immediately return our first ardour.
sold and my blood and my faith;
Then I can die for you!

Listen, listen, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear, hear

My children, rest there for a few moments to let the heat pass! ... on everything that is observed the discipline ... we are no longer here in an enemy country, and the first one who would address a hen or a rabbit, without my permission, would deal with me; you know that!
Devil takes me if I recognize my way! ... by making them make a detour I'm afraid I've lost myself in our mountains ...
Ah, tell me, boy, are we far from Hérissau, where is the whole regiment to meet tomorrow? ...
DANIEL after giving him a drink.

You don't need to hurry! ... in three hours of walking you will be there, and if you want, you and your company, stop at my farm that is there on your way, and spend the night there, nothing will miss you ... come to my house, Daniel Birman.
I've been told about you in the country... and I'm delighted to meet you and get to know you.
He'll only hold on to you, sergeant, because I wanted to ask you to enlist me.
You! ... then it's not that anymore.
If you really do, that's right; I'm leaving with you tomorrow morning, with the bag on your back, if you agree, because it has to end; I'm too unhappy!
I'm in love with a girl who doesn't want me.
The most beautiful girl in the country... she has a brother who is in the military and who you may have known? ...
Corporal Max Sterner... who, perhaps, will be back soon?

It's the same, for since he wrote to his sister to marry me, she doesn't want to hear about me anymore; she doesn't want to see me anymore, she sends me back! ... and I, who this morning had given her all my fortune by marriage contract ... I'm going to have to leave her by will... because I'm determined to get killed, and that's why I'm addressing you!
What the hell does that mean? ... and what is that like a face like that? ... Come here, my boy... So Bettly doesn't like his brother? ...

But if... she told me again this morning, she preferred me to everyone... but it's the marriage she doesn't like... she still wants to be a girl; it's her taste, her idea... she claims she can do without everyone... she doesn't need anyone! ...
It's a madness... a woman at her age needs support... a defender... and the best of all is a husband.
That's what I tell him all day!
Let her not see the need to get married! ... She repeated it to me just now, here, at home.
She sold, on the death of her father, the house that he had in the plain, and she bought this cottage.
Home! ... look for your papers ... your birth certificate ... it takes that to engage ... Isn't that what you were asking for? ...
Certainly! ... but it is that ... It is equal, Sergeant, I thank you no less ... for the good ideas you had! I will come back.
At the right time! ... Leave me alone.
And tomorrow... I'm going with you... although you gave me a moment of hope here... that made me lose the sorrow I had already...
Well... you'll go, a thousand cannons! ...
Is it rough and brutal, these soldiers? ... that's how I'll be tomorrow!
I'm leaving... I'm leaving... you can see it.
By this narrow path that leads to the village,
Who's coming over there? ... It's her! ah! if I thought so,
But no; no weakness, yes, let us show courage!
Let my orders by you be followed right now!
Oh, God, do you think about it, sergeant?
You who always preach in such a harsh tone
I answer you all! Start boldly;
I'll pay if I have to!
